title: Which numbers have five crore as every nearest neighbour?
description: A number has five crore as its nearest neighbour at the thousand, ten thousand, lakh, ten lakh and crore. The thousand place is the strictest, so the last three digits fix the least and the greatest such number, and the two sides are counted. Keeko then raises a hand, thinking only five crore itself works.
teaching_notes: One idea: the strictest place, the thousand, controls every wider place, so its last three digits fix both ends. Ask the class which place allows the smallest gap before any number is tried. Watch for students who say only five crore itself works.

source: Find all numbers whose five nearest neighbours are all 5,00,00,000, and say how many there are
video_script.why: The child can round to the thousand, lakh and crore, and now works backwards from the answer to every number that rounds to it.
video_script.substitution: Start with the strictest place, find the least and the greatest number that round to five crore, then count both sides.
video_script.anchor: The target 5,00,00,000 with the five places thousand, ten thousand, lakh, ten lakh and crore all pointing to it.
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko thinks only five crore itself has five crore as every nearest neighbour. Numbers just below and just above it also round to five crore, as long as the last three digits are in range.
video_script.payoff_line: There are one thousand such numbers

final_answer.value: All numbers from 4,99,99,500 to 5,00,00,499; there are 1000 of them
final_answer.spoken: all the numbers from four crore ninety nine lakh ninety nine thousand five hundred to five crore four hundred ninety nine, which is one thousand numbers

never_show: the least and greatest numbers written whole before the answer beat
maths_rules: the thousand place is the strictest: the last three digits decide, and the wider places allow larger gaps
below 5,00,00,000: numbers start 4,99,99; they round up only if the last three digits are 500 or more, so the least is 4,99,99,500; 4,99,99,499 rounds down to 4,99,99,000
from 5,00,00,000 upward: numbers start 5,00,00; they round down to 5,00,00,000 only if the last three digits are 499 or less, so the greatest is 5,00,00,499; 5,00,00,500 rounds up to 5,00,01,000
below side: 500 to 999 is 500 numbers; upper side: 000 to 499 is 500 numbers; 500 + 500 = 1000
check: 4,99,99,500 and 5,00,00,499 also round to 5,00,00,000 at ten thousand, lakh, ten lakh and crore
the slip: only 5,00,00,000 itself works; but 5,00,00,499 also rounds to 5,00,00,000
video_script.design: One idea: the strictest place decides, so find the least and greatest number and count. Wrong idea: Keeko says only five crore itself works. The anchor stays all video; the working band builds in the idea part; no hard clear.
